title: User fills frame
description: Hyperliquid's `userFills` stream (subscribed with aggregateByTime off) as the adapter publishes it (src/venues/hyperliquid/user.ts). Fills of other clients share the frame and are never dropped: only a numeric money field or an absent tid or oid refuses it, and cosmetic fields are carried as sent. Fills are in venue order: by time, and inside one millisecond by the startPosition chain (0003 §2.9). A fill's identity is `id` = venue:tid. The snapshot frame (`isSnapshot`) is admitted and deduplicated, never skipped.

unordered.description: (coin, millisecond) groups whose order the startPosition chain alone did not determine; the ledger re-orders them from the position before the group.

canonical.description: A canonical decimal string. Never a JSON number.

side.description: `unknown` when the venue sent neither B nor A; its text is in `venueSide`.

cloid.description: As the venue echoed it: 0x + 32 hex lower-cased, anything else verbatim (another client's order may carry any id).

crossed.description: True when the fill took liquidity.
